dex.entry: A dumpling-shaped cave-grub with a body fused to a piece of raw iron ore; it headbutts walls to eat mineral flakes, slowly growing heavier. The ore-grub that looks like it's been bolted to a rock — endearing clumsiness.

art.silhouette: Chubby grub-like body wrapped around a dark iron-ore lump; tiny arms, vestigial; rounded head with a wide flat mouth for scraping ore; small black eyes; warm grey-brown colouring.
